title.en: MALACAÑAN PALACE BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES ORGANIZING A CERTAIN PORTION OF THE MUNIC- IPALITY OF TUBOD, PROVINCE OF LANAO, INTO AN INDEPENDENT MUNICIPALITY UNDER THE NAME OF LALA, WITH THE SEAT OF GOVERNMENT AT THE BARRIO OF LALA.

text.en:
The municipality of Lala shall have the following barrios:
1. Barrio of Rawaan, which consists of the sitios of Sambulawan,
Andil, Magpatao, and Camayog;
2. Barrio Gumagamut, which consists of the sitios of San Isidro,
Cabasagan Dacu, Pinamparan, and Sumalig;
3. Barrio of Lala, the poblacion, which consists of the sitios of
Tuna-an, Calisig, Matampay, and San Isidro;
4. Barrio of Simpak, which consists of the sitios of Pinuyak,
and Masolon;
5. Barrio of Daromawang, which consists of the sitios of Mar-
got and Cogon;
6. Barrio of Abagan, which consists of the sitios of Rebe, Pan-
guil, and Balimbing-Maranding Crossing; and
7. Barrio Lanipao, which consists of the sitios of Pindolunan,
Cabasagan Gamay, and Badac.
The municipality of Lala shall begin to exist upon the
appointment and qualification of the mayor, vice-mayor
and a majority of the municipal councilors thereof.
Done in the City of Manila, this 22nd day of March,
in the year of our Lord, nineteen hundred and forty-nine,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the third.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
TEODORO EVANGELISTA
Executive Secretary
